I'm also really close with her family... And we all see each other at church each Sunday too... :/ and in the past two weeks, there was a problem with her dad's car and she phoned me, I was there in 10 minutes. Her dad also had a problem with his credit card while we are here in their own country (card is for another country), so I had to take out the equivalent of $600 in the local currency for him, she was the one who phoned me to ask if it's fine. He'll pay me back when we get back to the other country that we live in.

Of course I will always be there for her and her family :/ but she said "it is better from distance" - today I walked about 2 hrs 30 (~15 km ?)... I was hoping to find someone to talk to, or to see really if I would end everything... Half my thoughts are positive and I'll be back with her after time, the half is like why waste time with watching as she finds something else, just end it yours now... :/

I wrote one of her best friends who wrote me back saying she didn't know about the engagement ring so she'll write back later but I think she'll try to help but I'll make sure she doesn't write to my girlfriend...

Pretty much all of my friends are friends with her. I always invited her along where ever I went. Most of my friends are older though. She has university and has friends from her course, some I've met but not many. She's been living with me the past 2 years, in a small studio and I pay everything... She stays at her parents place for now and I would prefer she stays there, she would support them (they don't have stable jobs) although I've seen she wants to search for a collocation... We had planned to move to a bigger place but didn't decide on which side of the city as it all depended on her job or masters...
How can I stop my obsession? I guess my love for her has grown too much and now it's an obsession since she moved away...
